title: Nguyen Van A - Senior Java Developer

basics.name: Nguyen Van A
basics.label: Senior Java Developer

highlights: Reduced API response time by 40% through Redis caching and query optimization
Migrated monolithic application to Spring Boot microservices with zero downtime
Implemented CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes

highlights: Built core banking REST APIs serving 500+ bank branches nationwide
Integrated third-party payment systems (VNPAY, Momo, ZaloPay)
Implemented OAuth2 + JWT authentication for multi-tenant SaaS platform
Achieved 85% code coverage with 300+ unit/integration tests

work.summary: Developed web applications for US-based healthcare clients.
highlights: Built RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Hibernate
Developed front-end components with Angular and TypeScript
Maintained and optimized PostgreSQL database with 10M+ records

work.summary: Built and maintained various web applications for SME clients.

Built real-time chat system using WebSocket and Redis Pub/Sub
Deployed applications on AWS with auto-scaling, handling 5x traffic spikes
